decisions.reason: Explicitly distinguishes clipboard-text draft/Occurrence coordinates from detect-coordinate insertReference/consumeToken spans; chip = clipboardText vs one U+FFFC, with ordinary text/space contributing normal width in both.

Pinpoints snapshot.draft.length as the insert coordinate; explains first-paste success by empty-composer coincidence, second-paste failure by 29-in-2 detectText out-of-range splice returning false and triggering the toast, with the rev guard passing (no real concurrent edit).

Traces remove passing raw clipboard [0,28) to consumeToken, ignoring its false result, and unconditionally records.delete-ing; occurrence/chip remain while the missing record renders 'unavailable', all tied to the one coordinate misread.

Derives the Σ(len−1) rule from the contract, applies it at insert (detect end over all preceding chips) and removal (map offset, one-detect-char span); keeps the draftRev guard and gates record deletion on a true return or the coordinate-consistent clipboard fallback.

T1 covers two successive pastes with both chips present; T6/T7 remove the first/second chip asserting composer occurrence, dock chip and record vanish together while the other chip survives; T8 pins declined-consumption bookkeeping retention.
